description: This file contains CSS styles defining the appearance and layout of a React application, with specific theme management through CSS variables for both light and dark themes.

classes.name: App
classes.description: Main container class for the application that centers content and applies background and text colors based on the current theme.

classes.name: App-logo
classes.description: Class for the logo image in the application, which may have animations applied based on media queries.

classes.name: App-header
classes.description: Class for the header section of the application that holds content with specific styles for layout and transitions.

classes.name: App-link
classes.description: Class for links in the application, with transition effects for color changes.

classes.name: theme-toggle
classes.description: Class for the button allowing users to toggle between light and dark themes, with styles for different states.
